sentences.text:
This is third application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.148/2023 dated 26.04.2023 registered at Police Station Unchehra, District Satna for offence punishable under Sections 354 (C), 354 (D) and 376 of IPC.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 06.05.2023.
The applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready t o furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Trial will take considerable time to be concluded.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.

sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5. This third bail application has been argued on the ground that all material witnesses have been examined before the trial Court and most of them have turned hostile.
The earlier two bail applications were dismissed under M.Cr.C. No.29763/2023 and 43019/2023.
The certified copies of statements of eight prosecution witnesses examined before the trial Court have been produced in support of the bail application.
6. Taking this evidence into consideration and the changes brought on oath in the prosecution's case, this bail application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.

Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of (ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE DevS Adarsh Pratap Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173235116/
